product_charter.purpose: Personal trail preparation through local daily dossiers, user-authored training, geographic familiarity and fictional planning choices
product_charter.virtual_itinerary: 266 northbound sections; target 10 virtual miles; final 5.84 miles
product_charter.physical_training: Optional user-authored targets and explicit manual self-report; no supplied personalized prescription
product_charter.deployment: CMD to PowerShell to Python loopback service to a separate clean portable WebView2 host
product_charter.human_acceptance: Pending review; user instructions are product direction, not fabricated signed test acceptance

authority_matrix.mutation: Explicit eligible completion; expected campaign revision plus unique operation identity
User-authored assignment acceptance and explicit manual activity report
Authored finite options; no physical-target authority
Expected journal and experience revision; preserve original text on conflict
Rebuild into a separate empty directory; campaign itinerary SHA pinned
Metadata refresh independent from physical activity and campaign state

process_flow: PowerShell validates/reuses the owned local service
Python locks repository and checks schema/route pin
Additive experience migration takes a consistent pre-migration backup
WebView2 keeps main frame at the fixed loopback root
UI reads exact current day and independent visual/experience publications
POST validates origin, nonce, schema, operation and revisions
Domain writes and durable receipts commit before response
Eligible explicit completion commits current day and next pointer together

failure_handoffs.lost_response: Recover committed receipt by operation identity or replay exact request
failure_handoffs.stale_browser: 409; refresh committed state and preserve unsaved input
failure_handoffs.unavailable_network: Local geography/experience remain; external imagery has honest gaps
failure_handoffs.unsupported_schema: Refuse startup and preserve repository data
failure_handoffs.missing_content: Refuse structurally invalid publication; unavailable optional images preserve interaction
failure_handoffs.interrupted_migration: Transaction rolls back; consistent pre-migration backup remains

metric_dictionary.virtual_distance_miles: Marker-calibrated geographic story interval, not exercise
metric_dictionary.actual_distance_meters: Canonical conversion of explicit user-reported mi/km; null means unknown
metric_dictionary.duration_minutes: Explicit manual duration, not inferred from page timers
metric_dictionary.planning_tokens: Fictional finite planning currency; never physical energy/water
metric_dictionary.insight_stamps: Fictional learning collection; not a readiness score
metric_dictionary.campaign_revision: Number of committed explicit day completions
metric_dictionary.experience_revision: Separate serialized revision for authored assignment/activity/choice/journal actions

full_release_policy: Every one of the 3,720 child requirements remains mandatory until supported or explicitly dispositioned by an authorized reviewer. No exclusion or exception is silently accepted.
